answer: Each identity posts a violet bond of 100,000 POA locked in the island vault until the epoch settles, and every further identity from the same operator doubles the bond. When a vine audit traces two bonds to one operator, both identities are voided and their locked bonds and pending rewards are redistributed to honest peers. An operator running six fakes posts 6,300,000 POA in bonds and loses it all, far above the roughly 258,000 POA one fake could earn.
